zh-Hans.description: 亮黄色且半透明的美丽无壳海蛞蝓。

description: 外觀毛茸茸的像隻小白兔或小狗的超萌海蛞蝓。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: A super-cute nudibranch with a fluffy appearance like a little white rabbit or puppy.

zh-Hans.description: 外观毛茸茸的像只小白兔或小狗的超萌海蛞蝓。

description: 常會高舉腹部上下搖擺，身上有明顯的白色斑塊。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: Often lifts and sways its abdomen up and down, marked with distinct white patches.

zh-Hans.description: 常会高举腹部上下摇摆，身上有明显的白色斑块。

description: 雙螯會抓著小海葵像拿著彩球或拳擊手套防禦。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: Grips a small anemone in its claws, defending itself as if holding a colorful ball or boxing gloves.

zh-Hans.description: 双螯会抓着小海葵像拿着彩球或拳击手套防御。

description: 透明帶有紅色條紋，喜歡吃垃圾海葵。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: Translucent with red stripes, it favors feeding on garbage anemones.

zh-Hans.description: 透明带有红色条纹，喜欢吃垃圾海葵。

description: 身上覆蓋細毛，擅長清除藻類。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: Its body is covered in fine hairs, and it is adept at removing algae.

zh-Hans.description: 身上覆盖细毛，擅长清除藻类。

description: 背部有一條醒目的紅色與白色縱紋，會幫魚清理寄生蟲。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: A striking red-and-white longitudinal stripe runs along its back, and it cleans fish by removing parasites.

zh-Hans.description: 背部有一条醒目的红色与白色纵纹，会帮鱼清理寄生虫。

description: 外型奇特如蘭花，以海星為食的華麗蝦類。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: A gorgeous shrimp with an orchid-like shape that feeds on starfish.

zh-Hans.description: 外型奇特如兰花，以海星为食的华丽虾类。

description: 色彩極為鮮豔的濾食性海參，受驚會吐出有毒內臟。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: A strikingly colored, filter-feeding sea cucumber that ejects its toxic viscera when startled.

zh-Hans.description: 色彩极为鲜艳的滤食性海参，受惊会吐出有毒内脏。

description: 棲息在珊瑚上，展開的觸手像彩色的聖誕樹。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: Lives on corals, its unfurled tentacles resembling a colorful Christmas tree.

zh-Hans.description: 栖息在珊瑚上，展开的触手像彩色的圣诞树。

description: 常與海葵共生，擁有像濾網一樣的觸手用來捕捉浮游生物。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: Usually lives in symbiosis with anemones, using sieve-like tentacles to capture plankton.

zh-Hans.description: 常与海葵共生，拥有像滤网一样的触手用来捕捉浮游生物。

description: 身體細長像蜘蛛，有一個長長的吻部。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: Its elongated, spider-like body features a long, pointed rostrum.

zh-Hans.description: 身体细长像蜘蛛，有一个长长的吻部。

description: 幼體黑色，雄性藍色，雌性黃色的奇妙海鰻。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: A curious moray whose juveniles are black, males blue, and females yellow.

zh-Hans.description: 幼体黑色，雄性蓝色，雌性黄色的奇妙海鳗。

description: 成群將下半身埋在沙中，隨水流搖擺像海草。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: In groups, they bury their lower bodies in sand, swaying with the current like seaweed.

zh-Hans.description: 成群将下半身埋在沙中，随水流摇摆像海草。

description: 鮮黃色的隆頭魚，遇到危險會鑽進沙中。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: A bright yellow wrasse that burrows into the sand when threatened.

zh-Hans.description: 鲜黄色的隆头鱼，遇到危险会钻进沙中。

description: 藍紫色帶有六條橘色縱紋，眼睛紅色的小型隆頭魚。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: A small wrasse with blue-purple body, six orange stripes, and red eyes.

zh-Hans.description: 蓝紫色带有六条橘色纵纹，眼睛红色的小型隆头鱼。

description: 體型碩大，游動時裙邊會像佛朗明哥舞裙般波浪舞動。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: Its large body ripples like a flamenco dancer's skirt while swimming.

zh-Hans.description: 体型硕大，游动时裙边会像佛朗明哥舞裙般波浪舞动。

description: 覆蓋著螢光綠色絨毛狀觸手的珊瑚。
category: 礁岩微距奇珍與擬態獵手

en.description: A coral carpeted in fluorescent green, hair-like tentacles.

zh-Hans.description: 覆盖着萤光绿色绒毛状触手的珊瑚。
